lead.zh: 替团队做选择的人：不学原理，只学决策要看的维度——成本、锁定、合规、评测口径。
lead.en: For whoever chooses for the team: skip the mechanics, learn the dimensions a decision turns on — cost, lock-in, compliance, and how scores are produced.

steps: AI 产品 vs AI 模型
生成式 AI 合规义务

zh: 用三个维度对比「调 API」与「自己部署」的总成本
说出更换模型供应商之前必须核实的三件事
看一份供应商评测报告，判断哪些分数可以直接采信、哪些要打问号
en: Compare API usage against self-hosting on three cost dimensions
Name three things to verify before switching model vendors
Read a vendor's evaluation report and say which scores stand up and which need a question mark
